Name: Slightly Cuter Characters - SVE Edition
Author: Poltergeister
Description:
Works with SVE 1.11!

This mod edits the appearance of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE [/url]characters. Consider using it with my other mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic. [/url]This mod also has a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]seasonal version.[/url]

+++ Installation +++

Now comes as a Content Pack! Install like you normally would, by dropping the main file into your mod folder.
In the config, you can set "NoNose" to "true" (characters will be noseless) or "false" (characters will have noses).


+++ Thank yous +++

Many thanks to Minakie ,Somohexual and FlashShifter for their help with Content Patcher. Somohexual also did their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4648]own version of Cuter SVE[/url] so check that one out too :)

I hope you enjoy this mod!
